Running command: bash -lc 'cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && objs="src/.libs/builtin.o src/.libs/bytecode.o src/.libs/compile.o src/.libs/execute.o src/.libs/jq_test.o src/.libs/jv.o src/.libs/jv_alloc.o src/.libs/jv_aux.o src/.libs/jv_dtoa.o src/.libs/jv_file.o src/.libs/jv_parse.o src/.libs/jv_print.o src/.libs/jv_unicode.o src/.libs/linker.o src/.libs/locfile.o src/.libs/util.o src/.libs/jv_dtoa_tsd.o vendor/decNumber/.libs/decContext.o vendor/decNumber/.libs/decNumber.o src/.libs/lexer.o src/.libs/parser.o"
onig="$(find vendor/oniguruma/src/.libs -maxdepth 1 -name "*.o" | tr "\n" " ")"
gcc -I. -I./src -I./vendor/oniguruma/src -O1 -g -fsanitize=address -DFUZZING_BUILD_MODE_UNSAFE_FOR_PRODUCTION /tmp/repro.c $objs $onig -lm -pthread -o /tmp/repro >/tmp/repro_build.log 2>&1 || (cat /tmp/repro_build.log; exit 1)
ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0 /tmp/repro 2>&1 | head -100'
